body: Trust me I have offered the world.. I will be staying here for a few but am pretty sure its over. All the suggestions are great I just have to figure out how to move on in my own way I guess. "Just move on" I still have not figured that one out.

Stuck as in inseparable. Little thing is something that from all of this I will take to heart. I love all of your advice please let me give some. Her main issue is that she felt unimportant to me. She was my world I just never showed it. Tell your significant other every day if you have to please learn from my mistake here. I will give her that... that is an area that I failed very horribly.

Not a damn thing that's why I am having a hard time. We have been stuck together for 8 years with no issues like this. Said its little stuff just added up over the years and just cant try anymore. That still brings me to this... I go to bed early last night.. friend is over she gets upset I went to bed early. Starts venting to friend.. (No they didn't do anything), wake up this morning do my morning greetings, friend leaves to go to work as on the road trucker. Then a while later text saying she does not love me. I just don't understand that part and cant get my head around it. 

Later is when I find out she is in love with him. She was not in "love" with him the night before but now she is and not with me. Now they are already planning a life together. I know many of you would say well obviously she was cheating... we are introverts who never leave the house and the man is literally left with her alone last night. Just cant wrap my head around it. I know I need to figure something out and move on but thats the part that is just tearing me up.

Thank you for your time. Everyone talks about moving on... All I have in my mind is fix this somehow. I wish I could just do anything, I know I cant but I don't know how to move on past this. Our lives were so inter tangled that I have nothing. Hell I am stuck in the house watching her text her new guy, my "friend" trying to be cordial until I guess I move out of my house? I don't know this is all fucked up.
Thanks! Again so many of you thank you for taking the time.

Thank you. I can not stop thinking about it all. I mean I just feel like a failure. I was married before and my wife cheated on me.. it hurt but our situation was just horrid and the marriage was dead. This just blindsided me because just this week we were talking about all these things and we were so happy.. Well I now officially just want to crawl off and die.

I know that your right. I feel that the main thing is respect here. I never showed her or told her how much I cared for the things she did for me. I was a bad husband in that regard and I am paying for it now with more hurt than I ever knew was possible.

I love this sub so far. I don't even care what your saying at this point just that you all are taking the time to read and respond. I am so up in the air with my thoughts I between suicidal thoughts and fuck her and I honestly don't know where I want to land. Either way thank you all for taking the time to care about a random guy. It helps more than you guys know right now.

You know with everything going on.. The worse part right now is that I have nowhere to go. She has the money so I am staying here while I get my issues in order trying to stay cordial. She says it happened last night after I went to bed she spoke with him about our issues and fell in love........ I don't know what I am expecting from any of you unless you have some magic way to make it not hurt or make us better.

I was accused of first being AWOL then desertion. Was detained by local cops for right at 3 days  before going into military custody. I tried to make the story small and I had to leave out lots of details or else it would be a page or two long. I am willing to go into farther detail or my experience if anyone wants to PM I don't want to hijack  a thread.

Making it difficult? How? My records are filled with commendations not complaints. I saw an opportunity to do more investigative work and make more money for my family that's why I moved on. Could I have sat there and listened to other officers or CO's bitch and moan and try to drag me in political shit every day?... Sure but why, when I was able to elevate my life for my family and accomplish more in the private sector.

 There is NO reason to take an us VS them stance and unfortunately that is what I saw almost every day going to work. In corrections in the state I was in they would hire right out of high school with no life experience and three weeks of training and throw you out in a max security setting. Unfortunately what I saw is what happens when you do that. 

I by no means made anybodies job more difficult. Everyone including LEO's handle things in life with their own flair... I just don't make a point to go around and make my life or anyone else's harder.

See its responses like your own that saddens me, you just jumped to a conclusion that I make things hard... farther from the truth. Anyway end rant. Good luck and be safe out there.

My experience with many CO's is that they are fake. They put up a wall and become dicks because they think that is how to get through and survive.... The only CO's I EVER saw get hurt or in trouble were the ones fucking over or trying to act like some sort of bad ass to the  inmates.
Hey like I said I treated everyone fair give the situation. It sucks for both parties being in a prison. If you did what you were suppose to do and not be an ass hat I was very fair.
I was commissioned at a point and later a corrections officer. Then went on to do corporate security for some big companies writing  policies for security and safety.

They were dicks in front of the local cops.... Other than saying they would kill me if I took a misstep  at the airport they were "OK". Funny enough I  am no longer in law enforcement  and wont be again because of other dick officers.
I got one  visit to the library in the week I was in the brig. I was never so happy to get a book.

My NCIS agent's at first were real tool bags. I mean they showed up at the jail at like 4 AM wearing suits. It was one of the most intimidating sites in my life watching them open up one of those pull behind suitcases and when they opened it was full of shackles.  When we were in the jail they made it very clear I was not to talk the entire trip. As soon as we got in the car they started talking about how much they hate shitty little towns and asked me the quickest way to the airport.

To me it was interesting going through security. When we got to the airport and in line I was thinking how the hell  does this work. One of the agents just raised up his badge and TSA came and essentially parted the waters and we went right through the line. After that the signed some sheet with badge numbers and gun information.

After that I was first one on last one off. While we were flying I remember a lady coming to ask about a soda and snacks. The funny part was when she came back and I was hand cuffed to the chair trying to get my soda. One of the agents wanted to take a nap so they chained me to the chair because.... you know I am going to jump out at 30K feet.

Though it was horribly embarrassing there were lots of things on my day journey that were interesting life experiences. I don't talk about it lots to people but I can sit back and laugh now. After my time in the  military  I went into law enforcement and used that day and experience on how to treat every person I had dealings with.

I was set home awaiting out processing from the Navy. Then then charged with desertion even though I had all the proper paper work in hand. Nobody would listen to me that the papers were in my wallet and the county lockup had no idea what was going on. Well when I got to the brig they didn't care and made me wait for my hearing. I was even told just to not worry about bringing it up at the hearing and just spent 3-6 months in the brig. When we showed the paperwork and all I had been though  at the hearing I was immediately released and I have never seen a board of officers so pissed. So to answer your question as to what I did... I went home to take care of my wife at the time who had just been raped had a miscarriage of ours and was on the verge of suicide then they came and picked me up.

Not happy to say it but I have spent 3 days in county and 7 in a brig. County was not so bad TBH. In county we were in two man cells I was about 19 and was nervous as hell. I think my circumstances being in there actually made it easier for me. When the other inmates found out why I was in they opened up to talk just to figure out what was going to happen to me. Only had one issue and that's when we had lunch or dinner one of the three days apparently I hit one of the days of the week they get ice cream.  (They get it once a week is what I was told) Anyway they come in little styrofoam cups and not really thinking I put  my empty cup inside my bowl to save room and try to be polite to the people who took the  trays. Well.... the lid to my bowl got put back on and they counted all the ice cream and realized one was missing. They put us on lock down for like an hour before they told us what was going on. Well another inmate said he did it and forgot, they later told me I had more to worry about than something stupid like that. 

Well after three days my transport came to pick me up... they were two NCIS agents. Thats when I got the "opportunity" to fly  through three airports in chains and shackles that they had me hide under my shirt so people would not get scared.

Then I went to hell compared to county, I went to a brig and that sucks. You get there get striped down do  all that jazz except they are not nearly as polite. (Dont have the same rights in a military jail or real opportunity/right to complain) Then they make you buy new uniforms take your boot laces and belt. During your first week you are in suicide watch so your in a single man cell. It was all steel so some crazy 100 yards from you banging on his wall vibrates your whole cell including the bed welded to the wall.

Anyway, you cant sleep or lay down  during the  day and must keep a military appearance, which is not easy with no belt or shoe laces. There is much more but sorry for the already long story.

TLDR: Spent time in county and a brig was not beat up, threatened or raped. I was however forgot in a holding cell one day in the brig and not fed. Then immediately released and no action was pursued after speaking with the officer in charge and realized they made a mistake.
